This Camp shirt is unique and made using shirting fabrics from past seasons, mixed across patterns and weights. Each shirt is patchworked into a one‑off, then over‑dyed to pull everything together.
Please note: each shirt is unique, and pattern combinations will vary so we can not guarantee which pattern combination you will be sent.
Camp shirt is a larger, looser and more relaxed fit than our Road shirt, with the same open neck, or ‘camp’ style collar. As extra points of difference our Camp shirt has added details such as a back yoke with small pleats, an elongated hem with side splits and a larger collar and pocket to balance the proportions.
We always want to be aware of how we can reduce waste and add value to things that might otherwise not get used. Using leftover fabrics from past seasons, this shirting fabric is pieced together by hand and patchworked into shirts, then over-dyed (meaning no two are the same).
